Name: Simple Chest Upgrade
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Simple Chest Upgrade
Upgrade your wood and stone chests without emptying or replacing them. Keep their contents, colour and name while adding more storage.
[center][size=4][b]PC 1.3 — Backpack row fix[/b][/size]
Spare empty entries in the backpack inventory list no longer add a phantom one-slot row to upgraded chest menus. The grid follows purchased backpack capacity and keeps genuinely occupied overflow accessible.
Works with the existing compact scrolling menu and Backpack 1.7. Chest contents, capacities and transfer callbacks are retained. Keep your config.json when updating.
The optional Android downloads are separate editions and are unchanged by this PC update; install one edition at a time.[/center]

[heading]Upgrade Kits[/heading]
[b]Chest Upgrade Kit I — 70 slots[/b]
[list]
[*]Upgrades a regular Chest or Stone Chest into its Big version.[/*]
[*]Craft with [b]60 Wood + 1 Copper Bar[/b].[/*]
[*]Recipe unlocks automatically after learning the Big Chest or Big Stone Chest recipe.[/*]
[/list][b]Chest Upgrade Kit II — 120 slots[/b]
[list]
[*]Upgrades a Big Chest into a [b]Deluxe Chest[/b], or a Big Stone Chest into a [b]Deluxe Stone Chest[/b].[/*]
[*]Craft with [b]50 Hardwood + 5 Gold Bars[/b].[/*]
[*]Craft or upgrade to a Big Chest, receive Robin’s letter the next morning, then buy the recipe from her for [b]10,000g[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]Chest Upgrade Kit III — 240 slots[/b]
[list]
[*]Upgrades a Deluxe Chest or Deluxe Stone Chest into its Prismatic variant.[/*]
[*]Craft with [b]100 Hardwood + 5 Iridium Bars + 1 Prismatic Shard[/b].[/*]
[*]Apply or craft Kit II to qualify for Robin’s next-morning Prismatic workshop letter. Read it, then buy the Kit III recipe from Robin for [b]25,000g[/b].[/*]
[/list]Hold the matching kit, right-click a placed chest and confirm. Wrong or cancelled upgrades won’t consume your kit.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Silver and purple metal [b]C[/b] kit icons.[/*]
[*]Preserves chest contents, colour, position and name.[/*]
[*]Compact chest and backpack grids with independent scrolling, native colour/organise/fill-stack controls, and adjustable menu size and dark mode.[/*]
[*]Controller support and all 12 game languages.[/*]
[*]Supports Automate, Chests Anywhere and Simple Terminal’s Bigger Terminal.[/*]
[*]Existing upgraded chests and kits carry over when updating.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.1.10+[/b].
Extract the [b]SimpleChestUpgrade[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI. To update, close the game and replace the existing folder.
In multiplayer, every player should install the same version.
